boundaries.name: Plonky2GateLowering
boundaries.obligation: range_check, connect, mul_const_add, select and assert_bool lower to constraints with the semantics the model assigns them.

boundaries.name: PoseidonPermutationInCircuit
boundaries.obligation: The in-circuit Poseidon permutation computes the same function as the native sponge (the O-2 mirror obligation); both are the same opaque callback here.

boundaries.name: InCircuitNTT
boundaries.obligation: The range-checked in-circuit NTT computes the negacyclic product in Z_q[X]/(X^512+1), i.e. agrees with PolynomialProduct.mul.

boundaries.name: ConsumerDigestBinding
boundaries.obligation: Every consumer must connect message_digest to a digest recomputed in-circuit for its own context; the gadget leaves it a free input.

boundaries.name: ConsumerVerifyGateBinding
boundaries.obligation: Every consumer of new_conditional must bind the verify wire to an authenticated member_count decomposition; the gadget does not constrain it.

boundaries.name: WitnessGeneratorCompleteness
boundaries.obligation: ModQGenerator and CenterBitGenerator produce satisfying values for honest inputs; only their value rules are modelled.

boundaries.name: LatticeHardness
boundaries.obligation: NTRU/GPV unforgeability: satisfying the gate set does not imply the key holder produced the witness.

boundaries.name: ProofSystemSoundness
boundaries.obligation: A verifying plonky2 proof implies a satisfying witness exists.
